name: smwgraphics-parodius-non-sense-fantasy-pachinko
title: Parodius: Non-Sense Fantasy - Pachinko
description:
A mechanical silly background from Parodius Da. This stage has the player travessing the interiors of a pachinko machine, filled with flashing lights and nonsensical enemies, as expected from the Parodius series. Could fit a bonus or mechanical level, maybe.

UPDATE: Reripped from scratch. Uses way less tile, freeing more BG1 space. Palette has been moved to row 1. Better map 16 and sample level too. Moved from BG2 to the BG1.
